title: The 2020 Nobel prize for black-hole theory and galactic-center observations
summary: Penrose was cited for black-hole formation in general relativity; Genzel and Ghez for the Milky Way's center.
body: The Nobel Prize in Physics 2020 was divided: one half to Roger Penrose "for the discovery that black hole formation is a robust prediction of the general theory of relativity," and the other half jointly to Reinhard Genzel and Andrea Ghez for the discovery of a supermassive compact object at the center of our galaxy. The prize citation is a historical and institutional fact. It is not itself the observational papers of Genzel and Ghez.
